arguments.summary: Investigated various hypotheses for the 502s on the checkout page, but found that the actual issue was a cron job running in UTC time instead of local time, causing job scheduling issues. Also, the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, so the failed_jobs table is being exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the cron job configuration to ensure it is running in the correct timezone and address the reasons for the growing failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database.
